issuer.summary: f(x) Protocol, built by AladdinDAO, has run since 2023 with $134.3M of protocol TVL on Ethereum only and two audits. When ChainSecurity found a double-flash-loan access-control bypass in the router peripheral in April 2025 with over $2M at risk, it was fixed under responsible disclosure and never exploited.
facts: Two audits. OpenZeppelin f(x) v2, commit 56a47eab, 2025-03-27 → 2025-05-05: 1 Critical / 2 High / 7 Medium / 13 Low / 23 Note, 5 resolved.

ChainSecurity router-peripheral finding: auditor-found, responsibly disclosed, fixed, NEVER EXPLOITED. ⚠️ No ChainSecurity engagement is locatable publicly beyond the blog post — an unconfirmed absence.
⚠️ Held below 6.0: a small DAO with no external governance check over a complex multi-contract system. The disclosure response evidences engagement, not the absence of further issues.
